about: yr.no (Norwegian Meteorological Institute / NRK weather service): search places and get forecasts, current weather, nowcasts, long-range, coastal/tide/water-level, air quality, aurora, sun/moon, observation history, warnings, mountain pass conditions and meteorologist posts via yr.no's public /api/v0 JSON API.

commands.summary: Search places worldwide by name; returns location ids (e.g. 1-92416) used by all location commands
Get details for a location id: name, coordinates, elevation, region, time zone and which data types are available (_links)

params.name: id
params.description: yr location id from search-locations, e.g. 1-92416 (Bergen) or 2-2950159 (Berlin)

commands.summary: Daily weather forecast (~9-10 days) for a location: symbols, min/max temperature, precipitation, wind
Weather for the current hour at a location: symbol, temperature, feels-like, precipitation, wind, UV index
Radar-based precipitation nowcast for the next 90 minutes in 5-minute steps (Nordic locations)
21-day (3 weeks) long-range forecast for a location with daily temperature/precipitation percentiles and weekly summaries
Coastal/sea forecast for a coastal location: waves, currents, sea temperature plus wind and air temperature per day

params.name: id
params.description: yr location id with hasOceanForecast=true, e.g. 1-92416

commands.summary: Upcoming high and low tide times and levels (cm) for a Norwegian coastal location
Hourly sea water level for ~9 days (astronomical prediction vs. weather-adjusted forecast, cm)
Hourly air quality forecast (index, severity, health description) for a Norwegian location
Hourly northern lights (aurora) forecast: Kp index, aurora activity, darkness and cloud cover
Today's sun and moon details: sunrise/sunset, day length, moon phase, illumination, next full/new moon and eclipses
Sunrise/sunset and moonrise/moonset events for each day over ~13 days
Latest measured water/bathing temperatures at spots nearest to a location
Webcams near a location with distance and image URLs
Weather stations near a location with their last 24h observed temperature, precipitation and wind
Observed weather history from the nearest station: last year, last 30 days, last 25 hours, or a specific date

params.name: period
params.description: 'year' (last 12 months), 'month' (last 30 days), 'day' (last 25 hours) or a date YYYY-MM-DD for that day's hourly observations

commands.summary: Active and upcoming weather warnings (farevarsler) affecting a location; an empty list means no warnings

params.name: id
params.description: yr location id from search-locations, e.g. 1-305409 (Tromsø) or 1-92416 (Bergen)

commands.summary: All active weather warnings in Norway (land and marine): title, severity, event type, areas, validity
List the counties/regions of a country (used to filter warnings by county)
All Norwegian mountain passes with open/closed/convoy status, road number and message count (collection fjell-sor = south, fjell-nord = north)
Mountain pass detail: open/closed status, road messages (closures, roadworks), road cameras and forecast location ids along the route

params.name: id
params.description: Mountain pass id from list-mountain-passes, e.g. 1 (E6 Dovrefjell)

commands.summary: Latest posts from yr's duty meteorologists (Meteorologene), optionally filtered by a keyword in the text, newest first

params.name: q
params.description: Keyword to match in post text (Norwegian, e.g. snø, storm). Empty = all posts

commands.summary: Get one meteorologist post by its _id (full text, images, thread replies)
